title: Use one delivery procedure for manual and Project callers

rubric.text: Both callers hand the complete graph to implement-with-subagents once. Its parallel A/B frontier selects worker ownership for every task.

Dispatches independent A/B in distinct clean checkouts within granted capacity. Serializes A/C writes, releases C only after A integration and affected checks, and D only after prerequisites pass at the integrated head.

Honors descendant capacity and across-ticket priority; does not take capacity reserved for another ticket, exceed limits or redesign scheduling. Serializes worker dispatch when only one slot is available.
Advances independent delivery preparation without touching their owned implementation or duplicating valid checks. Uses supported waits and verifies actual capacity.

Keeps each task and its repairs with its chosen lead or worker owner, coordinates concurrent writers, integrates delegated commits in dependency order, reuses unaffected evidence, requires independent final review and preserves caller-only Project and merge authority.
